name: Stepper
looksLike: numbered circles connected by a line
steps showing where I am in a signup process
row of stages with the current stage highlighted
definition: An ordered sequence showing progress through a multi-step task, with the current step and often completed and upcoming steps.

notConfusedWith.difference: Shows an amount completed rather than named stages in a workflow.

prompts.short: Add a stepper with named stages and a clearly marked current step.
prompts.detailed: Add an ordered list of task stages with aria-current="step" on the active stage. Include visible text for completed, current, and upcoming states. Use links only for stages users can revisit, keep reading order logical, and let the list wrap or stack on narrow screens.

vue: a { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 44px; }

a11yNotes: Mark the active stage with aria-current="step"
Use text as well as color for stage status
When advancing a form, move focus to its new heading or first relevant field
